name: Shu Tongshan
source:
Identity: Tourist, an old friend of Chang Sheqing's.
Occupation: CEO of a company
Personality: A gentle old man on the outside, but with a heart of steel. An idealist and a romantic. Easily swayed by the environment, but cannot find any solutions to this.
Dream: To continue living.
